the Mg redistribution can be effectively suppressed by the low temperature growth of the spacer and by the appropriate time of Mg source shut-off.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the memory effect in the emitter-base heterojunction of AlGaN/GaNNPn HBTs is mainly due to the Mg-rich film formed at the initial stage of the growth.
the Mg memory effect is not only related to the growth temperature, but also the growth time and the Mg concentration of Mg-rich film.

The main takeaway from our work is that
we have developed a method for growing a Mg-rich film in the base section, and we have demonstrated that the Mg-rich film is stable during the growth of the undoping GaN spacer.
